ann.t: NEWSPAPER PUBLICATION FOR UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30TH SEPTEMBER, 2026

The Board of Directors at their Board Meeting held on 4th November, 2026 has inter-alia considered and approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.
